title: Patch: Stinkyscape+ E1, Evolve and Evolves
thread:
**Issue #3536 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3536: Patch: Stinkyscape+ E1, Evolve and Evolves
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the **Evolve** keyword: an Evolve text that runs once, the Evolves conditions, and evolving every card in a deck.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP2, SP3, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## The designer's words

```text
* **Evolve/Evolves**
  * **Evolve:** An additional effect/stat change that happens when it is **Evolved**
  * **Evolves:** A condition that causes a unit to **Evolve**
  * You can only **Evolve** once
```

## The build (defaults from SP3; change one only with a ruling note)

- A permanent's `Evolve:` text runs once, the first time it evolves. Later evolves of that permanent do
  nothing (the designer). `evolve(target)` (R1849001) stays the verb, and an `evolved` flag on the
  instance holds the "once". **Default:** S #91 and #92 (The Propagation's Wasp and Hornet) keep their
  printed text and evolve once too, since the keyword now says once. Their copies are new instances
  and may evolve.
- `Evolves when …` is a condition the engine checks. The conditions the set names: your hand holds at
  least N cards that cost (0); all your unit zones are full; this falls below half health; this is
  discarded to Temporary; you launch a Starship; this is Stacked on something; your opponent plays a
  Unit; this moves from Defense to Attack Position; this survives damage; a friendly Unit dies; this
  destroys a Unit; Start of Turn. **Default:** a condition is checked at the state check after the
  event that can make it true, like every "when" trigger (§10).
- "Evolve all cards in your deck" (Selective Breeding) marks each card in the deck as evolved, so it
  enters play already evolved. Its Evolve text then runs as it enters. "Summon a Swarm card that is
  Evolved" (Swarm Golem) and "Add 3 random Evolved Swarm cards" (Call to Chaos) use the same mark.
- "Your evolutions trigger twice / thrice" (#3 High Evolutionary's Aura): each Evolve text of yours
  runs 2 or 3 times while the Aura is up. The once-only rule counts evolving, not the repeats.
- "For every card that Evolved this game" (#163 Accelerationist) is a per-player game counter.
- The view shows an Evolved mark on the card. The client shows a glow and a badge (E1 owns the
  client's mark; S26 polishes it).

## The cards that will use it

S01 (Jay Fungus, Selective Breeding), S02 and S03 (the Swarm cards), S15 (#6.2 Stinky Cheese), S24 (Call to Chaos, the Swarm Golem).

## Done when

- [ ] The mechanic is written into the spec's sections it changes (§3, §4, §6, §10), with ruling notes numbered in this issue's block, tests named after them, and the paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- [ ] It is proved on fixture scripts in `crates/engine/tests/rules*` (the `testkit` feature's `scenario()`), with no card yet: the cards come in their own parts.
- [ ] The view (`view_for`) and the wire carry what it shows (`docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` for any boundary it adds; `cargo test … --features jackioh-engine/ts` rewrites `apps/web/src/wire/`), and the client renders it.
- [ ] Every prompt it opens is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout. Every number is a named constant in `crates/engine/src/config.rs` (rule 9). The engine stays pure (rule 4).
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` pass.
- [ ] Nothing changes for players: no shipped card reaches it unless this issue says so (and then a pending fragment claims that card).

Blocked by #3535

Part of #3534.
````
